Try as he might to distract the public - either with [indecorous comments
about senators' asses](https://zeteo.com/p/whats-behind-trumps-midterm-
obsession), or the continued unfolding of his disastrous war on Iran and
accompanying callousness about dead Iranians or even U.S. soldiers - Donald
Trump still cannot evade the reek of his ties to Jeffrey Epstein. In fact, the
story has just gotten much more foul.

The president of the United States faces a new and horrific allegation of
rape.

In a newly released [report](https://democrats-judiciary.house.gov/sites/evo-
subsites/democrats-judiciary.house.gov/files/evo-media-document/2026-10.hjc-
dems-staff-report-epstein-and-trump.pdf) from Democrats [on the House
Judiciary Committee](https://democrats-judiciary.house.gov/media-center/press-
releases/judiciary-democrats-report-details-mounting-evidence-linking-trump-
to-epstein-s-criminal-activities-and-doj-s-cover-up-specific-accounts-
involving-11-women-provide-more-evidence-of-potential-sex-crimes),
investigators say a **" growing body of evidence demonstrates that Donald
Trump was an active participant in Jeffrey Epstein's sexual abuse of young
women during the mid-to-late 1990s."**

Trump denies wrongdoing and insistently distances himself from the infamous
financier and sex offender. The report documents an extensive trail connecting
the pair, laying out how they allegedly worked in tandem, using glitzy
settings like beauty pageants as **" hunting grounds"** to prey on young women
and girls.

Of 11 women who tie Trump to Epstein's sex-trafficking operation, the report
states, five **" have directly accused Trump of raping or sexually assaulting
them in Epstein's company or direct physical presence."**

One case involves beauty pageant contestant Beatrice Keul.
